description: Returns a snapshot of the Hyperliquid perpetual market: number of markets, total open interest and 24h volume, breadth, open-interest-weighted funding, the top markets by 24h volume, price change, open interest or funding, and the largest 24h gainers and losers. Use it for market overviews, top movers or the most active markets.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.

sort_by.description: Column for the top list: "volume" (default, 24h volume), "change" (absolute 24h price change), "open_interest" or "funding" (absolute rate).

name: get_market_screener
title: Market screener
